title: SandpaneTaskEvent
description: Durable, replayable task log entry (specs/02 §3 task_events). Sequence is unique per task and strictly increasing; clients reconnect with afterSequence.

kind.description: Event kind. Core-emitted kinds include: task.created, status.changed, message.user, adapter.unavailable, scheduler.deferred, workspace.removing, workspace.removed, workspace.removal_failed, and (A6, design 2026-10-09 §3.6 item 8) git.apply.started (appended durably before the first host write), git.applied, git.apply.failed and git.apply.reconciled (restart reconciliation of an unterminated start: outcome applied, partial, not_applied or unknown, never assumed). Kinds are an open string set, not an enum. Agent-normalized kinds follow agent-event.schema.json type values.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload; for normalized agent events matches agent-event.schema.json.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC, assigned by Core (stable replays).
